starting_question: Does broad resemblance to cytosine deaminases specify substrate, and does bound methionine identify function? Published answer was known before the retrospective route checks.

paper_reported: Fold and catalytic groups support amidohydrolase membership; 14 cytosine derivatives showed no turnover.
Docking favored adenine/adenosine compounds; biochemical assays supported MTA, SAH and adenosine but not AMP or SAM.
Product-bound structure agreed with the predicted local arrangement.
2013 contrasting relatives show that aligned arginine presence/absence alone does not determine SAH activity.
our_live_queries: Read primary 2007 methods/results and 2013 comparisons.
Retrieved PDBe binding-site records: 1P1M and 2PLM metal contact residues H55/H57/H200/D279.
1P1M methionine contact positions: 114-116,136-137,139,148; 2PLM SIB contacts extend to E84,H173,H200,E203,D279.
Retrieved 1K70 cytosine-deaminase record: three histidines and an aspartate contact its metal; this was record comparison, not an independently computed alignment.

annotation_consequence: Biochemically supported SAH/MTA/adenosine deaminase activities; broad fold correspondence alone insufficient for the substrate name. Dominant physiological substrate and obligatory pathway remain unresolved by these checks.
experiment_dependence: Substrate assignments depend on authors' enzyme assays and product identification; pose confirmation depends on crystallography. No new wet-lab experiments, docking or superposition performed here.
reasoning_reported_vs_reconstructed: Authors explicitly describe selecting substrates after docking enrichment and report false-positive AMP. Our two retrospective evidence-subset routes and the inference limits from contact-record comparison are ours; authors' private deliberations are unknown.
verification_scope: Read relevant primary results and methods; live deposited binding-site API retrievals. Original API URLs lacking entity ID returned 404 and were repaired using current PDBe documentation. No repository changes or scientific-case runs.

verification_scope: Full primary text and live 1MJH contact record checked; published answer known.
